item-999: ["Funded MSc in Canada — how the money actually works (READ FIRST)","Reference · applies to every Canadian graduate entry","n/a — reference card","","In the United States a funded assistantship normally means a stipend PLUS a tuition waiver, so the stipend is yours to live on.
